summary: Reviewed all 36 units of the enrichment. Translations differ from the pre-enrichment state only by added parenthetical/'यानी' identifications; no effect, dose or other content was smuggled in; Hindi has no Latin letters or brackets; confidence values unchanged; low-confidence units 4, 12, 13, 22, 34 are enriched sparingly (undamaged names only, doubtful ones left to the gloss). phalapippalī = dried madana fruit pieces is endorsed as probable (units 11, 12: pieces 'drawn out of' the dried madana fruits, called phalapippalī and kept apart from majjā, kernel, which is named separately in 16, 17, 21, 22, 27); the translation rightly keeps 'pippalī' without 'long pepper', and the pañcakolaka pippalī is rightly long pepper. praseka 'excessive salivation / मुँह में पानी भर आना' is supportable (lālāsrāva) and the gloss keeps 'flow, trickling' separate. Errors: unit 11 note attributes the reading to commentators from memory; unit 12 karbudāra tag should be disputed. Minor: kovidāra and maruvaka tags, Hindi grammar in 19, arka English, yakṣman Hindi, unit 28 over-enrichment. No regrouping suggested. Madana, kuṭaja, bimbī, pratyakpuṣpī, nīpa, māṃsī, śaileyaka, surasā, aguru, guggulu, elā, kustumburu, vālaka, śrīveṣṭaka (probable) judged acceptable as tagged; reṇukā, rohiṇī, vidula, śaṇapuṣpī, sadāpuṣpī, ghoṇṭā (probable) fine as disputed/probable and not put in translations. Note: the karbudāra error has no separate patch because it is applied by the unit-12 gloss patch.
